resources.string: Raw packet capture (PCAPNG)
Limited export: captures only packets that pass through this local VPN while it remains active. It is not a complete device capture and does not decrypt traffic.
Before creating a capture

A PCAPNG file can contain IP addresses and packet content, including plaintext if an app sends it. Capture only traffic you own or are authorized to inspect. APK Sentinel does not preview, decrypt, upload, or automatically start this capture.

Start disclosure: after a second root-manager prompt, capture is limited to IPv4 TCP SYN/FIN/RST control packets with no payload. It stops within 60 seconds, 2 MB, or 2,000 packets. Output stays temporarily in app-private cache until you export it or erase local data.

Full-capture disclosure: after a separate root-manager prompt, allowlisted tcpdump captures IPv4/IPv6 packets on the selected fixed category. The selected bounded preset stops at its time, byte, or packet cap. Packet bytes stay app-private until a user chooses a SAF destination. Stop promptly; no TLS decryption or credential-safety claim is made.
